question: Which of the following cities hosted the National Workshop in July 2025, organised by the Union Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment to strengthen the implementation of the SMILE-B (Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise – Begging) scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Workshop** on the **SMILE-B** (Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise – Begging) scheme was organized in **Indore**, **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• This workshop was conducted on **July 10, 2024** (notably the most significant recent national gathering for this scheme), by the **Union Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**, **Government of India**.
 
• The primary objective of the workshop was to strengthen the implementation of the **SMILE-B** sub-scheme and facilitate the **rehabilitation** of persons engaged in the act of **begging**.
 
• **Indore** was selected as the host city due to its exemplary performance in social initiatives and its status as a leader in urban cleanliness and **social welfare** management.
 
• The event saw participation from more than **100 delegates**, including **Municipal Commissioners** and representatives from **30 pilot cities** across the **country**, along with officials from the **National Institute of Social Defence (NISD)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The SMILE Scheme:**
 
 
• Launched on **February 12, 2022**, the **SMILE** (Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise) scheme is a central sector umbrella initiative aimed at the welfare of marginalized groups.
 
• It encompasses two major sub-schemes: **SMILE-B**, which focuses on the **Comprehensive Rehabilitation of persons engaged in the act of Begging**, and **SMILE-T**, focused on the welfare of **Transgender persons**.
 
• The **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** has allocated a total budget of **Rs. 365 crore** for the implementation of this scheme for the **five-year** period from **2021-22** to **2025-26**.
 
 
 
• **Core Components of SMILE-B:**
 
 
• **Survey and Identification:** Identifying individuals engaged in begging through rigorous **field surveys** conducted by municipal authorities and **NGOs**.
 
• **Mobilization:** Encouraging individuals to move to **shelter homes** and access government services through persistent **counseling** and outreach.
 
• **Shelter and Resettlement:** Providing basic facilities like food, clothing, and safe living conditions in dedicated **rehabilitation centers**.
 
• **Education and Skill Development:** Offering vocational training and **skill-building** to ensure long-term **economic independence** and integration into mainstream society.
 
 
 
• **Implementing Agencies:**
 
 
• The scheme is implemented through **State Governments**, **Union Territory administrations**, **Local Urban Bodies**, and **Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs)**.
 
• The **National Institute of Social Defence (NISD)** and **National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC)** play pivotal roles in **capacity building** and financial support.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Pilot Cities Initiative:** Initially, **30 cities** across **India**, including **Delhi**, **Mumbai**, **Chennai**, **Kolkata**, **Bengaluru**, and **Hyderabad**, were selected to run **pilot projects** for the **rehabilitation** of persons in begging.
 
• **Convergence with Health Schemes:** Beneficiaries under the **SMILE-B** scheme are integrated with the **Ayushman Bharat** (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana) to ensure they receive **comprehensive health insurance** and medical treatment.
 
• **Social Security and Dignity:** The scheme aligns with the spirit of **Article 21** of the **Constitution of India**, which guarantees the **Right to Life with Dignity**, by focusing on **rehabilitation** rather than criminalization.
 
• **Data Management:** A centralized **portal** has been developed to track the **progress** of beneficiaries and maintain a database for **transparency** in fund utilization and **impact assessment**.
